$comment: Project files this plugin supplies, for `kit doctor` and `/kit-adopt`. Besides these, every agent in agents/ (as .claude/agents/<name>.md) and every skill in skills/ (as .claude/skills/<name>/ or .claude/commands/<name>.md) counts as kit-owned. A project hook in .claude/settings.json that runs one of `hookScripts` duplicates a kit hook.

partial..claude/rules/tooling-limits.md: The generic rows and the rules above the table come from the kit; keep only project-specific rows, in a file with another name.
partial.scripts/hooks/shell-edits.mjs: A project's own ledger scripts import it; retire it together with them (the session plugin lists those).
